other_conditions: Must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh
Must be registered under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Madhya Pradesh
Must possess a valid identity card issued by the Mandal
Must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months
Subsidy is available only once in a lifetime for the worker
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 10% of the loan amount for tool/equipment purchase, capped at ₹5,000.
documents_required: Valid identity card issued by the Mandal
